data.label: Fixed-speed cooling motor fraction
data.provenance_detail: PROVISIONAL-UNMEASURED — 0.30. Fraction of cooling load served by fixed-speed motors (not VFD). These motors produce load damping proportional to speed. Blocks demo export until measured.

data.label: Motor damping coefficient
data.provenance_detail: PROVISIONAL-UNMEASURED — 2.5 pu/pu. Affinity law basis. D_eff = (p_cooling/p_demand) x fixed_speed_cooling_fraction x d_motor ~0.13 at nominal operating point. Blocks demo export until measured.

data.label: UFLS stage definitions
data.provenance_detail: PROVISIONAL-UNMEASURED — 3 stages. No measured basis. Thresholds and delays must be confirmed against site relay coordination study. Blocks demo export until measured.

data.label: 81U relay under-frequency trip threshold (islanded)
data.provenance_detail: PROVISIONAL-UNMEASURED — 57.5 Hz. No measured basis for islanded operation. NOTE: island_collapse_hz (IEEE 1547 Cat I = 57.0 Hz) is for grid-connected DER interconnection and must not be used as the islanded protection threshold. This PROVISIONAL value replaces it for islanded mode. Blocks demo export until measured.

data.label: 81U relay clearing delay
data.provenance_detail: PROVISIONAL-UNMEASURED — 0.10 s (100 ms). No measured basis. Time from threshold crossing to generator trip. Blocks demo export until measured.
